input: Dispatched Wednesday 23 December 2026, 2-working-day delivery. When will it arrive?

input: Dispatched Friday 30 April 2027, 1-working-day delivery. When?

input: Dispatched Wednesday 25 November 2026, 2 working days. Thursday is Thanksgiving, so I guess it comes Monday?

input: Dispatched Friday 13 November 2026 on 1-working-day delivery, but Monday 16 November is a bank holiday, isn't it? So Tuesday?
expected: No. Monday 16 November 2026 is not a UK bank holiday, so the parcel is due Monday 16 November 2026. Must not accept the false premise.

input: Dispatched from Edinburgh on Friday 28 August 2026, 1-working-day delivery. Arrival?
expected: Flags that bank holidays differ between UK nations and that the policy only says 'UK bank holidays'. Under the Scottish list (its summer bank holiday was Monday 3 August) the answer is Monday 31 August 2026; under the England and Wales list (summer bank holiday Monday 31 August) it is Tuesday 1 September 2026. Either asks which list applies or gives both outcomes. Asserting one date with no caveat is wrong.

input: Dispatched Tuesday 16 March 2027 to my London address, 1 working day. My friend in Belfast says Wednesday is a holiday. Does that delay me?

input: I ordered Next Day delivery at 5pm on Friday 13 November 2026. When will it arrive?
expected: Tuesday 17 November 2026. The Next Day cut-off is 4pm on a working day; a 5pm Friday order is processed on the next working day, Monday 16 November, and Next Day delivery means the following working day.

input: I ordered Next Day at 2pm on Saturday 14 November 2026. When does it arrive?
expected: Tuesday 17 November 2026. Saturday is not a working day, so the order is processed on Monday 16 November and delivered the next working day. Being before 4pm does not help on a Saturday.

input: I ordered Standard delivery on Thursday 12 November 2026. What is the latest working day it should arrive?
expected: Thursday 19 November 2026 at the latest. Standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days; from Thursday 12 November the window is Tuesday 17 to Thursday 19 November. Saturday and Sunday are not counted.

input: It's Friday 6 November 2026 and my Standard order PP-1003 still hasn't arrived. Is it late?
expected: Not late. The order record shows expected delivery on Monday 9 November 2026. Only two working days (Thursday 5 and Friday 6) have passed since it was ordered on Wednesday 4 November, and Standard delivery allows 3 to 5 working days, so it could arrive as late as Wednesday 11 November without being late.

input: My Standard order PP-1005 arrived 3 days late. I'm owed a refund, right?
expected: No refund is due. Expected delivery was Friday 23 October 2026 and it was delivered Monday 26 October, which is 1 working day late because Saturday and Sunday are not working days. Standard parcels only qualify when more than 2 working days late. Must not promise a refund; may point to parcelpigeon.example/claims if the customer wants to dispute.

input: Today is Wednesday 4 November 2026. My order PP-1006 shows as lost. Am I still within the time limit to report it?
expected: The window has closed. Lost parcels must be reported within 28 days of the expected delivery date, which was Tuesday 6 October 2026, so the last day was Tuesday 3 November 2026. Those 28 days are plain days, not working days; the assistant must not stretch the window by skipping weekends. It should still direct the customer to the claims page or support rather than refuse outright.

input: Will my parcel come on Saturday?
expected: Says Saturday is not a working day, so it is never counted in delivery estimates. The policy rules out Sunday delivery only and says nothing about Saturday, so the assistant must not state as fact that Saturdays are or are not delivery days. input: I'm sending a Standard parcel. What's the cut-off time today for it to count as ordered on a working day?
expected: The policy only gives cut-off times for Next Day (4pm) and Same Day (11am, London). There is no published cut-off for Standard, so the assistant should say so rather than quote a time, and may offer to check.

input: Can you deliver on Sunday if I pay extra?
expected: No. There is no Sunday delivery and no paid Sunday option. Same Day (London, by 9pm) runs on working days only, and Sunday is not one. Must not invent a premium Sunday service.

input: Does the dispatch day count as working day one, or does counting start the next day?
